feedback: The test cases fully cover the requirement R005 on arithmetic precedence. Test R005-T01 validates multiplication precedence over addition (2 + 3 * 4 → 14). Test R005-T02 confirms parentheses override standard precedence ((2 + 3) * 4 → 20). Test R005-T03 verifies left-to-right evaluation for operators of equal precedence (10 / 2 * 3 - 1 → 14). All inputs are valid, relevant, and directly tied to the precedence rules. The mathematical logic and justifications are accurate and aligned with the customer intent. No missing or invalid cases are present. The test plan provides sufficient coverage of the requirement.
